name: ARA4007
title: Mixed text content
summary: Text appears directly between elements; native UI text lives in text elements.
html:
Text appears directly between elements; native UI text lives in text elements.

#Common causes

  • Inline text written HTML-style.

#Fixes

  • Wrap the text in a text element and put it in the text attribute.

  • Code: ARA4007

  • Constant: ui::MIXED_TEXT

  • Reported by: ara-ui-document
